2702private:
2703
2704 void ReoptimizeTree()
2705 {
2706 check(!DirtyElementTree && !bDynamicTree);
2707 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(TAABBTree::ReoptimizeTree);
2708 TArray<FElement> AllElements;
2709
2710 int32 ReserveCount = DirtyElements.Num() + GlobalPayloads.Num();
2711 for (int LeafIndex = 0; LeafIndex < Leaves.Num(); LeafIndex++)
2712 {
2713 const TLeafType& Leaf = Leaves[LeafIndex];
2714 ReserveCount += static_cast<int32>(Leaf.GetReserveCount());
2715 }
2716
2717 AllElements.Reserve(ReserveCount);
2718
2719 AllElements.Append(DirtyElements);
2720 AllElements.Append(GlobalPayloads);
2721
2722 for (int LeafIndex = 0; LeafIndex < Leaves.Num(); LeafIndex++)
2723 {
2724 TLeafType& Leaf = Leaves[LeafIndex];
2725 Leaf.GatherElements(AllElements);
2726 }
2727
2728 TAABBTree NewTree(AllElements);
2729 *this = NewTree;
2730 bShouldRebuild = true; // No changes since last time tree was built
2731 }
2732
2733 // Returns true if the query should continue
2734 // Execute a function for all cells found in a query as well as the overflow
2735 template <typename FunctionType>
2736 bool DoForHitGridCellsAndOverflow(TArray<DirtyGridHashEntry>& HashEntryForOverlappedCells, FunctionType Function) const
2737 {
2738
2739 // Now merge and iterate the lists of elements found in the overlapping cells
2740 bool DoneWithGridElements = false;
2741 bool DoneWithNonGridElements = false;
2742 int NonGridElementIter = 0;
2743 while (!DoneWithGridElements || !DoneWithNonGridElements)
2744 {
2745 // Get the next dirty element index
2746
2747 int32 SmallestDirtyParticleIndex = INT_MAX; // Best dirty particle index to find
2748
2749 if (!DoneWithGridElements)
2750 {
2751 // Find the next smallest index
2752 // This will start slowing down if we are overlapping a lot of cells
2753 DoneWithGridElements = true;
2754 for (const DirtyGridHashEntry& HashEntry : HashEntryForOverlappedCells)
2755 {
2756 int32 Count = HashEntry.Count;
2757 if (Count > 0)
2758 {
2759 int32 DirtyParticleIndex = FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices[HashEntry.Index];
2760 if (DirtyParticleIndex < SmallestDirtyParticleIndex)
2761 {
2762 SmallestDirtyParticleIndex = DirtyParticleIndex;
2763 DoneWithGridElements = false;
2764 }
2765 }
2766 }
2767 }
2768
2769 // Now skip all elements with the same best index
2770 if (!DoneWithGridElements)
2771 {
2772 for (DirtyGridHashEntry& HashEntry : HashEntryForOverlappedCells)
2773 {
2774 int32 Count = HashEntry.Count;
2775 if (Count > 0)
2776 {
2777 int32 DirtyParticleIndex = FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices[HashEntry.Index];
2778 if (DirtyParticleIndex == SmallestDirtyParticleIndex)
2779 {
2780 ++HashEntry.Index; // Increment Index
2781 --HashEntry.Count; // Decrement count
2782 }
2783 }
2784 }
2785 }
2786
2787 DoneWithNonGridElements = NonGridElementIter >= DirtyElementsGridOverflow.Num();
2788 if (DoneWithGridElements && !DoneWithNonGridElements)
2789 {
2790 SmallestDirtyParticleIndex = DirtyElementsGridOverflow[NonGridElementIter];
2791 ++NonGridElementIter;
2792 }
2793
2794 // Elements that are in the overflow should not also be in the grid
2795 ensure(DoneWithGridElements || PayloadToInfo.Find(DirtyElements[SmallestDirtyParticleIndex].Payload)->DirtyGridOverflowIdx == INDEX_NONE);
2796
2797 if ((!DoneWithGridElements || !DoneWithNonGridElements))
2798 {
2799 const int32 Index = SmallestDirtyParticleIndex;
2800 const auto& Elem = DirtyElements[Index];
2801
2802 if (!Function(Elem))
2803 {
2804 return false;
2805 }
2806 }
2807 }
2808 return true;
2809 }
2810
2817 template <EAABBQueryType Query, typename SQVisitor>
2818 bool OverlapCached(const FAABB3& QueryBounds, SQVisitor& Visitor, bool& bOverlapResult) const
2819 {
2820 bool bCouldUseCache = false;
2821 bOverlapResult = true;
2822 // Only the overlap queries could use the caching
2823 if (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap && Visitor.GetQueryPayload())
2824 {
2825 // Grab the payload from the visitor (only available on physics thread for now) and retrieve the info
2826 const TPayloadType& QueryPayload = *static_cast<const TPayloadType*>(Visitor.GetQueryPayload());
2827 if( const FAABBTreePayloadInfo* QueryInfo = PayloadToInfo.Find(QueryPayload))
2828 {
2829 const int32 LeafIndex = QueryInfo->LeafIdx;
2830 if(LeafIndex != INDEX_NONE && LeafIndex < (OverlappingOffsets.Num()-1))
2831 {
2832 //Once we have the leaf index we can loop over the overlapping leaves
2833 for(int32 OverlappingIndex = OverlappingOffsets[LeafIndex];
2834 OverlappingIndex < OverlappingOffsets[LeafIndex+1]; ++OverlappingIndex)
2835 {
2836 const TLeafType& OverlappingLeaf = Leaves[OverlappingLeaves[OverlappingIndex]];
2837 if (OverlappingLeaf.OverlapFast(QueryBounds, Visitor) == false)
2838 {
2839 bOverlapResult = false;
2840 break;
2841 }
2842 }
2843 bCouldUseCache = true;
2844 }
2845 }
2846 }
2847 return bCouldUseCache;
2848 }
2849
2850 template <EAABBQueryType Query, typename TQueryFastData, typename SQVisitor>
2851 bool QueryImp(const FVec3& RESTRICT Start, TQueryFastData& CurData, const FVec3& QueryHalfExtents, const FAABB3& QueryBounds, SQVisitor& Visitor, const FVec3& Dir, const FVec3& InvDir, const bool bParallel[3]) const
2852 {
2853 PHYSICS_CSV_CUSTOM_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsCounters, MaxDirtyElements, DirtyElements.Num(), ECsvCustomStatOp::Max);
2854 PHYSICS_CSV_CUSTOM_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsCounters, MaxNumLeaves, Leaves.Num(), ECsvCustomStatOp::Max);
2855 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, QueryImp);
2856 //QUICK_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(AABBTreeQueryImp);
2857#if !WITH_EDITOR
2858 //CSV_SCOPED_TIMING_STAT(ChaosPhysicsTimers, AABBTreeQuery)
2859#endif
2860 FReal TOI = 0;
2861 {
2862 //QUICK_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(QueryGlobal);
2863 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, QueryImp_Global);
2864 for(const auto& Elem : GlobalPayloads)
2865 {
2866 if (PrePreFilterHelper(Elem.Payload, Visitor))
2867 {
2868 continue;
2869 }
2870
2871 const FAABB3 InstanceBounds(Elem.Bounds.Min(), Elem.Bounds.Max());
2872 if(TAABBTreeIntersectionHelper<TQueryFastData,Query>::Intersects(Start, CurData, TOI, InstanceBounds, QueryBounds, QueryHalfExtents, Dir, InvDir, bParallel))
2873 {
2874 TSpatialVisitorData<TPayloadType> VisitData(Elem.Payload,true, InstanceBounds);
2875 bool bContinue;
2876 if(Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
2877 {
2878 bContinue = Visitor.VisitOverlap(VisitData);
2879 } else
2880 {
2881 bContinue = Query == EAABBQueryType::Sweep ? Visitor.VisitSweep(VisitData,CurData) : Visitor.VisitRaycast(VisitData,CurData);
2882 }
2883
2884 if(!bContinue)
2885 {
2886 return false;
2887 }
2888 }
2889 }
2890 }
2891
2892 if (DirtyElementTree)
2893 {
2894 if (!DirtyElementTree->template QueryImp<Query, TQueryFastData, SQVisitor>(Start, CurData, QueryHalfExtents, QueryBounds, Visitor, Dir, InvDir, bParallel))
2895 {
2896 return false;
2897 }
2898 }
2899 else if (bMutable)
2900 { // Returns true if we should continue
2901 auto IntersectAndVisit = [&](const FElement& Elem) -> bool
2902 {
2903 const FAABB3 InstanceBounds(Elem.Bounds.Min(), Elem.Bounds.Max());
2904 if (PrePreFilterHelper(Elem.Payload, Visitor))
2905 {
2906 return true;
2907 }
2908
2909 if (TAABBTreeIntersectionHelper<TQueryFastData, Query>::Intersects(Start, CurData, TOI, InstanceBounds, QueryBounds, QueryHalfExtents, Dir, InvDir, bParallel))
2910 {
2911 TSpatialVisitorData<TPayloadType> VisitData(Elem.Payload, true, InstanceBounds);
2912 bool bContinue;
2913 if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
2914 {
2915 bContinue = Visitor.VisitOverlap(VisitData);
2916 }
2917 else
2918 {
2919 bContinue = Query == EAABBQueryType::Sweep ? Visitor.VisitSweep(VisitData, CurData) : Visitor.VisitRaycast(VisitData, CurData);
2920 }
2921
2922 if (!bContinue)
2923 {
2924 return false;
2925 }
2926 }
2927 return true;
2928 };
2929
2930 //QUICK_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(QueryDirty);
2931 if (DirtyElements.Num() > 0)
2932 {
2933 bool bUseGrid = false;
2934
2935 if (DirtyElementGridEnabled() && CellHashToFlatArray.Num() > 0)
2936 {
2937 if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
2938 {
2939 bUseGrid = !TooManyOverlapQueryCells(QueryBounds, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv, DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount);
2940 }
2941 else if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Raycast)
2942 {
2943 bUseGrid = !TooManyRaycastQueryCells(Start, CurData.Dir, CurData.CurrentLength, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv, DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount);
2944 }
2945 else if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Sweep)
2946 {
2947 bUseGrid = !TooManySweepQueryCells(QueryHalfExtents, Start, CurData.Dir, CurData.CurrentLength, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv, DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount);
2948 }
2949 }
2950
2951 if (bUseGrid)
2952 {
2953 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, QueryImp_DirtyElementsGrid);
2954 TArray<DirtyGridHashEntry> HashEntryForOverlappedCells;
2955
2956 auto AddHashEntry = [&](int32 QueryCellHash)
2957 {
2958 const DirtyGridHashEntry* HashEntry = CellHashToFlatArray.Find(QueryCellHash);
2959 if (HashEntry)
2960 {
2961 HashEntryForOverlappedCells.Add(*HashEntry);
2962 }
2963 return true;
2964 };
2965
2966 if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
2967 {
2968 DoForOverlappedCells(QueryBounds, DirtyElementGridCellSize, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv, AddHashEntry);
2969 }
2970 else if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Raycast)
2971 {
2972 DoForRaycastIntersectCells(Start, CurData.Dir, CurData.CurrentLength, DirtyElementGridCellSize, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv, AddHashEntry);
2973 }
2974 else if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Sweep)
2975 {
2976 DoForSweepIntersectCells(QueryHalfExtents, Start, CurData.Dir, CurData.CurrentLength, DirtyElementGridCellSize, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv,
2977 [&](FReal X, FReal Y)
2978 {
2979 int32 QueryCellHash = HashCoordinates(X, Y, DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv);
2980 const DirtyGridHashEntry* HashEntry = CellHashToFlatArray.Find(QueryCellHash);
2981 if (HashEntry)
2982 {
2983 HashEntryForOverlappedCells.Add(*HashEntry);
2984 }
2985 });
2986 }
2987
2988 if (!DoForHitGridCellsAndOverflow(HashEntryForOverlappedCells, IntersectAndVisit))
2989 {
2990 return false;
2991 }
2992 } // end overlap
2993
2994 else
2995 {
2996 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, QueryImp_DirtyElements);
2997 for (const auto& Elem : DirtyElements)
2998 {
2999 if (!IntersectAndVisit(Elem))
3000 {
3001 return false;
3002 }
3003 }
3004 }
3005 }
3006 }
3007
3008 struct FNodeQueueEntry
3009 {
3010 int32 NodeIdx;
3011 FReal TOI;
3012 };
3013
3014 // Caching is for now only available for dynanmic tree
3015 if (bDynamicTree && !OverlappingLeaves.IsEmpty())
3016 {
3017 // For overlap query and dynamic tree we are using the cached overlapping leaves
3018 bool bOverlapResult = true;
3019 if (OverlapCached<Query, SQVisitor>(QueryBounds, Visitor, bOverlapResult))
3020 {
3021 return bOverlapResult;
3022 }
3023 }
3024
3025 constexpr int32 MaxNodeStackNumOnSystemStack = 255;
3026 TArray<FNodeQueueEntry, TSizedInlineAllocator<MaxNodeStackNumOnSystemStack,32> > NodeStack;
3027
3028 if (bDynamicTree)
3029 {
3030
3031 if (RootNode != INDEX_NONE)
3032 {
3033 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{RootNode, 0});
3034 }
3035 }
3036 else if (Nodes.Num())
3037 {
3038 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{ 0, 0 });
3039 }
3040
3041// Slow debug code
3042//#if !WITH_EDITOR
3043// if (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
3044// {
3045// CSV_CUSTOM_STAT(ChaosPhysicsTimers, OverlapCount, 1, ECsvCustomStatOp::Accumulate);
3046// CSV_CUSTOM_STAT(ChaosPhysicsTimers, DirtyCount, DirtyElements.Num(), ECsvCustomStatOp::Max);
3047// }
3048//#endif
3049
3050
3051 VectorRegister4Double StartSimd;
3052 VectorRegister4Double DirSimd;
3053 VectorRegister4Double Parallel;
3054 VectorRegister4Double InvDirSimd;
3055 VectorRegister4Double LengthSimd;
3056
3057 if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Raycast)
3058 {
3059 StartSimd = VectorLoadDouble3(&Start.X);
3060 DirSimd = VectorLoadDouble3(&Dir.X);
3061 Parallel = VectorCompareGT(GlobalVectorConstants::DoubleSmallNumber, VectorAbs(DirSimd));
3062 InvDirSimd = VectorBitwiseNotAnd(Parallel, VectorDivide(VectorOne(), DirSimd));
3063 LengthSimd = VectorSetDouble1(CurData.CurrentLength);
3064 }
3065
3066 while (NodeStack.Num())
3067 {
3068 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, QueryImp_NodeTraverse);
3069
3070//#if !WITH_EDITOR
3071// if (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
3072// {
3073// CSV_CUSTOM_STAT(ChaosPhysicsTimers, AABBCheckCount, 1, ECsvCustomStatOp::Accumulate);
3074// }
3075//#endif
3076 const FNodeQueueEntry NodeEntry = NodeStack.Pop(EAllowShrinking::No);
3077 if constexpr (Query != EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
3078 {
3079 if (NodeEntry.TOI > CurData.CurrentLength)
3080 {
3081 continue;
3082 }
3083 }
3084
3085 const FNode& Node = Nodes[NodeEntry.NodeIdx];
3086 if (Node.bLeaf)
3087 {
3088 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, NodeTraverse_Leaf);
3089 const auto& Leaf = Leaves[Node.ChildrenNodes[0]];
3090 if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
3091 {
3092 if (Leaf.OverlapFast(QueryBounds, Visitor) == false)
3093 {
3094 return false;
3095 }
3096 }
3097 else if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Sweep)
3098 {
3099 if (Leaf.SweepFast(Start, CurData, QueryHalfExtents, Visitor, Dir, InvDir, bParallel) == false)
3100 {
3101 return false;
3102 }
3103 }
3104 else if (Leaf.RaycastFastSimd(StartSimd, CurData, Visitor, DirSimd, InvDirSimd, Parallel, LengthSimd) == false)
3105 {
3106 return false;
3107 }
3108 }
3109 else
3110 {
3111 PHYSICS_CSV_SCOPED_VERY_EXPENSIVE(PhysicsVerbose, NodeTraverse_Branch);
3112 int32 Idx = 0;
3113
3114 if constexpr (Query != EAABBQueryType::Overlap)
3115 {
3116 bool bIntersect0, bIntersect1;
3117 FReal TOI0, TOI1;
3118 if constexpr (Query == EAABBQueryType::Raycast)
3119 {
3120 FAABBVectorizedDouble AABBVectorized(Node.ChildrenBounds[0]);
3121 VectorRegister4Double TOISimd;
3122 bIntersect0 = AABBVectorized.RaycastFast(StartSimd, InvDirSimd, Parallel, LengthSimd, TOISimd);
3123 VectorStoreDouble1(TOISimd, &TOI0);
3124
3125 AABBVectorized = FAABBVectorizedDouble(Node.ChildrenBounds[1]);
3126 bIntersect1 = AABBVectorized.RaycastFast(StartSimd, InvDirSimd, Parallel, LengthSimd, TOISimd);
3127 VectorStoreDouble1(TOISimd, &TOI1);
3128 }
3129 else
3130 {
3131 FAABB3 AABB0(Node.ChildrenBounds[0].Min(), Node.ChildrenBounds[0].Max());
3132 bIntersect0 = TAABBTreeIntersectionHelper<TQueryFastData, Query>::Intersects(Start, CurData, TOI0, AABB0, QueryBounds, QueryHalfExtents, Dir, InvDir, bParallel);
3133
3134 FAABB3 AABB1(Node.ChildrenBounds[1].Min(), Node.ChildrenBounds[1].Max());
3135 bIntersect1 = TAABBTreeIntersectionHelper<TQueryFastData, Query>::Intersects(Start, CurData, TOI1, AABB1, QueryBounds, QueryHalfExtents, Dir, InvDir, bParallel);
3136 }
3137 if (bIntersect0 && bIntersect1)
3138 {
3139 if (TOI1 > TOI0)
3140 {
3141 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{Node.ChildrenNodes[1], TOI1});
3142 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{Node.ChildrenNodes[0], TOI0});
3143 }
3144 else
3145 {
3146 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{Node.ChildrenNodes[0], TOI0});
3147 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{ Node.ChildrenNodes[1], TOI1 });
3148 }
3149 }
3150 else if (bIntersect0)
3151 {
3152 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{Node.ChildrenNodes[0], TOI0});
3153 }
3154 else if (bIntersect1)
3155 {
3156 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{ Node.ChildrenNodes[1], TOI1 });
3157 }
3158 }
3159 else
3160 {
3161 for (const TAABB<T, 3>&AABB : Node.ChildrenBounds)
3162 {
3163 if (TAABBTreeIntersectionHelper<TQueryFastData, Query>::Intersects(Start, CurData, TOI, FAABB3(AABB.Min(), AABB.Max()), QueryBounds, QueryHalfExtents, Dir, InvDir, bParallel))
3164 {
3165 NodeStack.Emplace(FNodeQueueEntry{ Node.ChildrenNodes[Idx], TOI });
3166 }
3167 ++Idx;
3168 }
3169 }
3170 }
3171 }
3172
3173 return true;
3174 }
3175
3176 int32 GetNewWorkSnapshot()
3177 {
3178 if(WorkPoolFreeList.Num())
3179 {
3180 return WorkPoolFreeList.Pop();
3181 }
3182 else
3183 {
3184 return WorkPool.AddDefaulted(1);
3185 }
3186 }
3187
3188 void FreeWorkSnapshot(int32 WorkSnapshotIdx)
3189 {
3190 //Reset for next time they want to use it
3191 WorkPool[WorkSnapshotIdx] = FWorkSnapshot();
3192 WorkPoolFreeList.Add(WorkSnapshotIdx);
3193
3194 }
3195
3196 template <typename TParticles>
3197 void GenerateTree(const TParticles& Particles)
3198 {
3199 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_AABBTreeGenerateTree);
3200 this->SetAsyncTimeSlicingComplete(false);
3201
3202 ensure(WorkStack.Num() == 0);
3203
3204 int32 NumParticles = 0;
3205 constexpr bool bIsValidParticleArray = !std::is_same_v<TParticles, std::nullptr_t>;
3206 if constexpr (bIsValidParticleArray)
3207 {
3208 NumParticles = Particles.Num();
3209 }
3210
3211 const int32 ExpectedNumLeaves = NumParticles / MaxChildrenInLeaf;
3212 const int32 ExpectedNumNodes = ExpectedNumLeaves;
3213
3214 WorkStack.Reserve(ExpectedNumNodes);
3215
3216 const int32 CurIdx = GetNewWorkSnapshot();
3217 FWorkSnapshot& WorkSnapshot = WorkPool[CurIdx];
3218 WorkSnapshot.Elems.Reserve(NumParticles);
3219
3220
3221 GlobalPayloads.Reset();
3222 Leaves.Reset();
3223 Nodes.Reset();
3224 RootNode = INDEX_NONE;
3225 FirstFreeInternalNode = INDEX_NONE;
3226 FirstFreeLeafNode = INDEX_NONE;
3227 DirtyElements.Reset();
3228 CellHashToFlatArray.Reset();
3229 FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices.Reset();
3230 DirtyElementsGridOverflow.Reset();
3231 if (DirtyElementTree)
3232 {
3233 DirtyElementTree->Reset();
3234 }
3235
3236 TreeStats.Reset();
3237 TreeExpensiveStats.Reset();
3238 PayloadToInfo.Reset();
3239 NumProcessedThisSlice = 0;
3240
3241 StartSliceTimeStamp = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
3242
3243 GetCVars(); // Safe to copy CVARS here
3244
3245 if (bDynamicTree)
3246 {
3247 int32 Idx = 0;
3248 if constexpr (bIsValidParticleArray)
3249 {
3250 for (auto& Particle : Particles)
3251 {
3252 bool bHasBoundingBox = HasBoundingBox(Particle);
3253 auto Payload = Particle.template GetPayload<TPayloadType>(Idx);
3254 TAABB<T, 3> ElemBounds = ComputeWorldSpaceBoundingBox(Particle, false, (T)0);
3255
3256 UpdateElement(Payload, ElemBounds, bHasBoundingBox);
3257 ++Idx;
3258 }
3259 }
3260 this->SetAsyncTimeSlicingComplete(true);
3261 return;
3262 }
3263
3264 WorkSnapshot.Bounds = TAABB<T, 3>::EmptyAABB();
3265
3266 {
3267 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_AABBTreeTimeSliceSetup);
3268
3269 // Prepare to find the average and scaled variance of particle centers.
3270 WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter = FVec3(0);
3271 WorkSnapshot.ScaledCenterVariance = FVec3(0);
3272
3273 int32 Idx = 0;
3274
3275 //TODO: we need a better way to time-slice this case since there can be a huge number of Particles. Can't do it right now without making full copy
3276 TVec3<T> CenterSum(0);
3277
3278 if constexpr (bIsValidParticleArray)
3279 {
3280 for (auto& Particle : Particles)
3281 {
3282 bool bHasBoundingBox = HasBoundingBox(Particle);
3283 auto Payload = Particle.template GetPayload<TPayloadType>(Idx);
3284 TAABB<T, 3> ElemBounds = ComputeWorldSpaceBoundingBox(Particle, false, (T)0);
3285
3286 // If bounds are bad, use global so we won't screw up splitting computations.
3287 if (bHasBoundingBox && ValidateBounds(ElemBounds) == false)
3288 {
3289 bHasBoundingBox = false;
3290 ensureMsgf(false, TEXT("AABBTree encountered invalid bounds input. Forcing element to global payload. Min: %s Max: %s."),
3291 *ElemBounds.Min().ToString(), *ElemBounds.Max().ToString());
3292 }
3293
3294
3295 if (bHasBoundingBox)
3296 {
3297 if (ElemBounds.Extents().Max() > MaxPayloadBounds)
3298 {
3299 bHasBoundingBox = false;
3300 }
3301 else
3302 {
3303 FReal NumElems = (FReal)(WorkSnapshot.Elems.Add(FElement{ Payload, ElemBounds }) + 1);
3304 WorkSnapshot.Bounds.GrowToInclude(ElemBounds);
3305
3306 // Include the current particle in the average and scaled variance of the particle centers using Welford's method.
3307 TVec3<T> CenterDelta = ElemBounds.Center() - WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter;
3308 WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter += CenterDelta / (T)NumElems;
3309 WorkSnapshot.ScaledCenterVariance += (ElemBounds.Center() - WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter) * CenterDelta;
3310 }
3311 }
3312 else
3313 {
3314 ElemBounds = TAABB<T, 3>(TVec3<T>(TNumericLimits<T>::Lowest()), TVec3<T>(TNumericLimits<T>::Max()));
3315 }
3316
3317 if (!bHasBoundingBox)
3318 {
3319 if (bMutable)
3320 {
3321 PayloadToInfo.Add(Payload, FAABBTreePayloadInfo{ GlobalPayloads.Num(), INDEX_NONE, INDEX_NONE, INDEX_NONE });
3322 }
3323 GlobalPayloads.Add(FElement{ Payload, ElemBounds });
3324 }
3325
3326 ++Idx;
3327 //todo: payload info
3328 }
3329 }
3330 }
3331
3332 NumProcessedThisSlice = NumParticles; //todo: give chance to time slice out of next phase
3333
3334 {
3335 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_AABBTreeInitialTimeSlice);
3336 WorkSnapshot.NewNodeIdx = 0;
3337 WorkSnapshot.NodeLevel = 0;
3338
3339 //push root onto stack
3340 WorkStack.Add(CurIdx);
3341
3342 SplitNode();
3343 }
3344
3345 /* Helper validation code
3346 int32 Count = 0;
3347 TSet<int32> Seen;
3348 if(WorkStack.Num() == 0)
3349 {
3350 int32 LeafIdx = 0;
3351 for (const auto& Leaf : Leaves)
3352 {
3353 Validate(Seen, Count, Leaf);
3354 bool bHasParent = false;
3355 for (const auto& Node : Nodes)
3356 {
3357 if (Node.bLeaf && Node.ChildrenNodes[0] == LeafIdx)
3358 {
3359 bHasParent = true;
3360
3361 break;
3362 }
3363 }
3364 ensure(bHasParent);
3365 ++LeafIdx;
3366 }
3367 ensure(Count == 0 || Seen.Num() == Count);
3368 ensure(Count == 0 || Count == Particles.Num());
3369 }
3370 */
3371
3372 }

3374 enum eTimeSlicePhase
3375 {
3376 PreFindBestBounds,
3377 DuringFindBestBounds,
3378 ProcessingChildren
3379 };
3380
3381 struct FSplitInfo
3382 {
3383 TAABB<T, 3> RealBounds; //Actual bounds as children are added
3384 int32 WorkSnapshotIdx; //Idx into work snapshot pool
3385 };
3386
3387 struct FWorkSnapshot
3388 {
3389 FWorkSnapshot()
3390 : TimeslicePhase(eTimeSlicePhase::PreFindBestBounds)
3391 {
3392
3393 }
3394
3395 eTimeSlicePhase TimeslicePhase;
3396
3397 TAABB<T, 3> Bounds;
3398 TArray<FElement> Elems;
3399
3400 // The average of the element centers and their variance times the number of elements.
3401 TVec3<T> AverageCenter;
3402 TVec3<T> ScaledCenterVariance;
3403
3404 int32 NodeLevel;
3405 int32 NewNodeIdx;
3406
3407 int32 BestBoundsCurIdx;
3408
3409 FSplitInfo SplitInfos[2];
3410 };
3411
3412 int32 GetLastIndexToProcess(int32 CurrentIndex)
3413 {
3414 int32 LastNodeToProcessIndex = 0;
3415 if (FAABBTimeSliceCVars::bUseTimeSliceMillisecondBudget)
3416 {
3417 // When TimeSlicing by a millisecond budget, try to process all nodes.
3418 // We will stop if we ran out of time and continue on the next frame
3419 LastNodeToProcessIndex = WorkPool[CurrentIndex].Elems.Num();
3420 }
3421 else
3422 {
3423 const bool WeAreTimeslicing = (MaxNumToProcess > 0);
3424 const int32 NumWeCanProcess = MaxNumToProcess - NumProcessedThisSlice;
3425 LastNodeToProcessIndex = WeAreTimeslicing ? FMath::Min(WorkPool[CurrentIndex].BestBoundsCurIdx + NumWeCanProcess, WorkPool[CurrentIndex].Elems.Num()) : WorkPool[CurrentIndex].Elems.Num();
3426 }
3427
3428 return LastNodeToProcessIndex;
3429 }
3430
3431 bool CanContinueProcessingNodes(bool bOnlyUseTimeStampCheck = true)
3432 {
3433 bool bCanDoWork = true;
3434
3435 if (FAABBTimeSliceCVars::bUseTimeSliceMillisecondBudget)
3436 {
3437 bool bCheckIfHasAvailableTime = false;
3438
3439 if (bOnlyUseTimeStampCheck)
3440 {
3441 bCheckIfHasAvailableTime = true;
3442 }
3443 else
3444 {
3445 // Checking for platform time every time is expensive, so only do it between a configured amount of elements.
3446 // This means we might overshoot the budget, but on the other hand we will keep most of the time doing actual work.
3447 CurrentProcessedNodesSinceChecked++;
3448 if (CurrentProcessedNodesSinceChecked > FAABBTimeSliceCVars::MinNodesChunkToProcessBetweenTimeChecks)
3449 {
3450 CurrentProcessedNodesSinceChecked = 0;
3451 bCheckIfHasAvailableTime = true;
3452 }
3453 }
3454
3455 if (bCheckIfHasAvailableTime)
3456 {
3457 const double ElapsedTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds() - StartSliceTimeStamp;
3458 const bool WeAreTimeslicing = FAABBTimeSliceCVars::MaxProcessingTimePerSliceSeconds > 0 && MaxNumToProcess > 0;
3459 if (WeAreTimeslicing && !FMath::IsNearlyZero(StartSliceTimeStamp) && ElapsedTime > FAABBTimeSliceCVars::MaxProcessingTimePerSliceSeconds)
3460 {
3461 // done enough
3462 bCanDoWork = false;
3463 }
3464 }
3465 }
3466 else
3467 {
3468 const bool WeAreTimeslicing = (MaxNumToProcess > 0);
3469 if (WeAreTimeslicing && (NumProcessedThisSlice >= MaxNumToProcess))
3470 {
3471 // done enough
3472 bCanDoWork = false;
3473 }
3474 }
3475
3476 return bCanDoWork;
3477 }
3478
3479 void FindBestBounds(const int32 StartElemIdx, int32& InOutLastElem, FWorkSnapshot& CurrentSnapshot, int32 MaxAxis, const TVec3<T>& SplitCenter)
3480 {
3481 const T SplitVal = SplitCenter[MaxAxis];
3482
3483 // add all elements to one of the two split infos at this level - root level [ not taking into account the max number allowed or anything
3484 for (int32 ElemIdx = StartElemIdx; ElemIdx < InOutLastElem; ++ElemIdx)
3485 {
3486 const FElement& Elem = CurrentSnapshot.Elems[ElemIdx];
3487 int32 BoxIdx = 0;
3488 const TVec3<T> ElemCenter = Elem.Bounds.Center();
3489
3490 // This was changed to work around a code generation issue on some platforms, don't change it without testing results of ElemCenter computation.
3491 //
3492 // NOTE: This needs review. TVec3<T>::operator[] should now cope with the strict aliasing violation which caused the original codegen breakage.
3493 T CenterVal = ElemCenter[0];
3494 if (MaxAxis == 1)
3495 {
3496 CenterVal = ElemCenter[1];
3497 }
3498 else if(MaxAxis == 2)
3499 {
3500 CenterVal = ElemCenter[2];
3501 }
3502
3503 const int32 MinBoxIdx = CenterVal <= SplitVal ? 0 : 1;
3504
3505 FSplitInfo& SplitInfo = CurrentSnapshot.SplitInfos[MinBoxIdx];
3506 FWorkSnapshot& WorkSnapshot = WorkPool[SplitInfo.WorkSnapshotIdx];
3507 T NumElems = (T)(WorkSnapshot.Elems.Add(Elem) + 1);
3508 SplitInfo.RealBounds.GrowToInclude(Elem.Bounds);
3509
3510 // Include the current particle in the average and scaled variance of the particle centers using Welford's method.
3511 TVec3<T> CenterDelta = ElemCenter - WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter;
3512 WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter += CenterDelta / NumElems;
3513 WorkSnapshot.ScaledCenterVariance += (ElemCenter - WorkSnapshot.AverageCenter) * CenterDelta;
3514
3515 constexpr bool bOnlyUSeTimeStampCheck = false;
3516 if (!CanContinueProcessingNodes(bOnlyUSeTimeStampCheck))
3517 {
3518 // If we ended before processing all the requested nodes, update the out last element index variable
3519 const bool bIsProcessingLastRequestedIndex = ElemIdx == InOutLastElem - 1;
3520 InOutLastElem = bIsProcessingLastRequestedIndex ? InOutLastElem : ElemIdx + 1;
3521 break; // done enough
3522 }
3523 }
3524
3525 NumProcessedThisSlice += InOutLastElem - StartElemIdx;
3526 }
3527
3528 void SplitNode()
3529 {
3530 while (WorkStack.Num())
3531 {
3532 //NOTE: remember to be careful with this since it's a pointer on a tarray
3533 const int32 CurIdx = WorkStack.Last();
3534
3535 if (WorkPool[CurIdx].TimeslicePhase == eTimeSlicePhase::ProcessingChildren)
3536 {
3537 //If we got to this it must be that my children are done, so I'm done as well
3538 WorkStack.Pop(EAllowShrinking::No);
3539 FreeWorkSnapshot(CurIdx);
3540 continue;
3541 }
3542
3543 const int32 NewNodeIdx = WorkPool[CurIdx].NewNodeIdx;
3544
3545 // create the actual node space but might no be filled in (YET) due to time slicing exit
3546 if (NewNodeIdx >= Nodes.Num())
3547 {
3548 Nodes.AddDefaulted((1 + NewNodeIdx) - Nodes.Num());
3549 }
3550
3551 if (!CanContinueProcessingNodes())
3552 {
3553 return; // done enough
3554 }
3555
3556 auto& PayloadToInfoRef = PayloadToInfo;
3557 auto& LeavesRef = Leaves;
3558 auto& NodesRef = Nodes;
3559 auto& WorkPoolRef = WorkPool;
3560 auto& TreeExpensiveStatsRef = TreeExpensiveStats;
3561 auto MakeLeaf = [NewNodeIdx, &PayloadToInfoRef, &WorkPoolRef, CurIdx, &LeavesRef, &NodesRef, &TreeExpensiveStatsRef]()
3562 {
3563 if (bMutable)
3564 {
3565 //todo: does this need time slicing in the case when we have a ton of elements that can't be split?
3566 //hopefully not a real issue
3567 for (const FElement& Elem : WorkPoolRef[CurIdx].Elems)
3568 {
3569 PayloadToInfoRef.Add(Elem.Payload, FAABBTreePayloadInfo{ INDEX_NONE, INDEX_NONE, LeavesRef.Num() });
3570 }
3571 }
3572
3573 NodesRef[NewNodeIdx].bLeaf = true;
3574 NodesRef[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenNodes[0] = LeavesRef.Add(TLeafType{ WorkPoolRef[CurIdx].Elems }); //todo: avoid copy?
3575 };
3576
3577 if (WorkPool[CurIdx].Elems.Num() <= MaxChildrenInLeaf || WorkPool[CurIdx].NodeLevel >= MaxTreeDepth)
3578 {
3579
3580 MakeLeaf();
3581 WorkStack.Pop(EAllowShrinking::No); //finished with this node
3582 FreeWorkSnapshot(CurIdx);
3583 continue;
3584 }
3585
3586 if (WorkPool[CurIdx].TimeslicePhase == eTimeSlicePhase::PreFindBestBounds)
3587 {
3588 //Add two children, remember this invalidates any pointers to current snapshot
3589 const int32 FirstChildIdx = GetNewWorkSnapshot();
3590 const int32 SecondChildIdx = GetNewWorkSnapshot();
3591
3592 //mark idx of children into the work pool
3593 WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos[0].WorkSnapshotIdx = FirstChildIdx;
3594 WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos[1].WorkSnapshotIdx = SecondChildIdx;
3595
3596 for (FSplitInfo& SplitInfo : WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos)
3597 {
3598 SplitInfo.RealBounds = TAABB<T, 3>::EmptyAABB();
3599 }
3600
3601 WorkPool[CurIdx].BestBoundsCurIdx = 0;
3602 WorkPool[CurIdx].TimeslicePhase = eTimeSlicePhase::DuringFindBestBounds;
3603 const int32 ExpectedNumPerChild = WorkPool[CurIdx].Elems.Num() / 2;
3604 {
3605 WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].Elems.Reserve(ExpectedNumPerChild);
3606 WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].Elems.Reserve(ExpectedNumPerChild);
3607
3608 // Initialize the the two info's element center average and scaled variance.
3609 WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].AverageCenter = TVec3<T>(0);
3610 WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].ScaledCenterVariance = TVec3<T>(0);
3611 WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].AverageCenter = TVec3<T>(0);
3612 WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].ScaledCenterVariance = TVec3<T>(0);
3613 }
3614
3615 if (!CanContinueProcessingNodes())
3616 {
3617 // done enough
3618 return;
3619 }
3620 }
3621
3622 if (WorkPool[CurIdx].TimeslicePhase == eTimeSlicePhase::DuringFindBestBounds)
3623 {
3624 int32 LastIdxToProcess = GetLastIndexToProcess(CurIdx);
3625
3626 // Determine the axis to split the AABB on based on the SplitOnVarianceAxis console variable. If it is not 1, simply use the largest axis
3627 // of the work snapshot bounds; otherwise, select the axis with the greatest center variance. Note that the variance times the number of
3628 // elements is actually used but since all that is needed is the axis with the greatest variance the scale factor is irrelevant.
3629 const int32 MaxAxis = (FAABBTreeCVars::SplitOnVarianceAxis != 1) ? WorkPool[CurIdx].Bounds.LargestAxis() :
3630 (WorkPool[CurIdx].ScaledCenterVariance[0] > WorkPool[CurIdx].ScaledCenterVariance[1] ?
3631 (WorkPool[CurIdx].ScaledCenterVariance[0] > WorkPool[CurIdx].ScaledCenterVariance[2] ? 0 : 2) :
3632 (WorkPool[CurIdx].ScaledCenterVariance[1] > WorkPool[CurIdx].ScaledCenterVariance[2] ? 1 : 2));
3633
3634 // Find the point where the AABB will be split based on the SplitAtAverageCenter console variable. If it is not 1, just use the center
3635 // of the AABB; otherwise, use the average of the element centers.
3636 const TVec3<T>& Center = (FAABBTreeCVars::SplitAtAverageCenter != 1) ? WorkPool[CurIdx].Bounds.Center() : WorkPool[CurIdx].AverageCenter;
3637
3638 FindBestBounds(WorkPool[CurIdx].BestBoundsCurIdx, LastIdxToProcess, WorkPool[CurIdx], MaxAxis, Center);
3639 WorkPool[CurIdx].BestBoundsCurIdx = LastIdxToProcess;
3640
3641 if (!CanContinueProcessingNodes())
3642 {
3643 // done enough
3644 return;
3645 }
3646 }
3647
3648 const int32 FirstChildIdx = WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos[0].WorkSnapshotIdx;
3649 const int32 SecondChildIdx = WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos[1].WorkSnapshotIdx;
3650
3651 const bool bChildrenInBothHalves = WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].Elems.Num() && WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].Elems.Num();
3652
3653 // if children in both halves, push them on the stack to continue the split
3654 if (bChildrenInBothHalves)
3655 {
3656 Nodes[NewNodeIdx].bLeaf = false;
3657
3658 Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenBounds[0] = WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos[0].RealBounds;
3659 WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].Bounds = Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenBounds[0];
3660 Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenNodes[0] = Nodes.Num();
3661
3662 Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenBounds[1] = WorkPool[CurIdx].SplitInfos[1].RealBounds;
3663 WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].Bounds = Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenBounds[1];
3664 Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenNodes[1] = Nodes.Num() + 1;
3665
3666 WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].NodeLevel = WorkPool[CurIdx].NodeLevel + 1;
3667 WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].NodeLevel = WorkPool[CurIdx].NodeLevel + 1;
3668
3669 WorkPool[FirstChildIdx].NewNodeIdx = Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenNodes[0];
3670 WorkPool[SecondChildIdx].NewNodeIdx = Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenNodes[1];
3671
3672 //push these two new nodes onto the stack
3673 WorkStack.Add(SecondChildIdx);
3674 WorkStack.Add(FirstChildIdx);
3675
3676 // create the actual node so that no one else can use our children node indices
3677 const int32 HighestNodeIdx = Nodes[NewNodeIdx].ChildrenNodes[1];
3678 Nodes.AddDefaulted((1 + HighestNodeIdx) - Nodes.Num());
3679
3680 WorkPool[CurIdx].TimeslicePhase = eTimeSlicePhase::ProcessingChildren;
3681 }
3682 else
3683 {
3684 //couldn't split so just make a leaf - THIS COULD CONTAIN MORE THAN MaxChildrenInLeaf!!!
3685 MakeLeaf();
3686 WorkStack.Pop(EAllowShrinking::No); //we are done with this node
3687 FreeWorkSnapshot(CurIdx);
3688 }
3689 }
3690
3691 check(WorkStack.Num() == 0);
3692 //Stack is empty, clean up pool and mark task as complete
3693
3694 this->SetAsyncTimeSlicingComplete(true);
3695 }

3697 TArray<TPayloadType> FindAllIntersectionsImp(const FAABB3& Intersection) const
3698 {
3699 struct FSimpleVisitor
3700 {
3701 FSimpleVisitor(TArray<TPayloadType>& InResults) : CollectedResults(InResults) {}
3702 bool VisitOverlap(const TSpatialVisitorData<TPayloadType>& Instance)
3703 {
3704 CollectedResults.Add(Instance.Payload);
3705 return true;
3706 }
3707 bool VisitSweep(const TSpatialVisitorData<TPayloadType>& Instance, FQueryFastData& CurData)
3708 {
3709 check(false);
3710 return true;
3711 }
3712 bool VisitRaycast(const TSpatialVisitorData<TPayloadType>& Instance, FQueryFastData& CurData)
3713 {
3714 check(false);
3715 return true;
3716 }
3717
3718 bool PrePreFilter(const TPayloadType&) const { return false; }
3719
3721 const void* GetQueryPayload() const
3722 {
3723 return nullptr;
3724 }
3725
3726 bool HasBlockingHit() const
3727 {
3728 return false;
3729 }
3730
3731 TArray<TPayloadType>& CollectedResults;
3732 };
3733
3734 TArray<TPayloadType> Results;
3735 FSimpleVisitor Collector(Results);
3736 Overlap(Intersection, Collector);
3737
3738 return Results;
3739 }

3741 // Set InOutMaxSize to less than 0 for unlimited
3742 //
3743 template<typename ContainerType>
3744 static void AddToContainerHelper(const ContainerType& ContainerFrom, ContainerType& ContainerTo, int32 Index)
3745 {
3746 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<ContainerType, TArrayAsMap<TPayloadType, FAABBTreePayloadInfo>>)
3747 {
3748 ContainerTo.AddFrom(ContainerFrom, Index);
3749 }
3750 else if constexpr(std::is_same_v<ContainerType, TSQMap<TPayloadType, FAABBTreePayloadInfo>>)
3751 {
3752 ContainerTo.AddFrom(ContainerFrom, Index);
3753 }
3754 else
3755 {
3756 ContainerTo.Add(ContainerFrom[Index]);
3757 }
3758 }
3759
3760 template<typename ContainerType>
3761 static int32 ContainerElementSizeHelper(const ContainerType& Container, int32 Index)
3762 {
3763 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<ContainerType, TArray<TAABBTreeLeafArray<TPayloadType, true>>>)
3764 {
3765 return sizeof(typename TArray<TAABBTreeLeafArray<TPayloadType, true>>::ElementType) + sizeof(typename decltype(Container[Index].Elems)::ElementType) * Container[Index].GetElementCount();
3766 }
3767 else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<ContainerType, TArray<TAABBTreeLeafArray<TPayloadType, false>>>)
3768 {
3769 return sizeof(typename TArray<TAABBTreeLeafArray<TPayloadType, false>>::ElementType) + sizeof(typename decltype(Container[Index].Elems)::ElementType) * Container[Index].GetElementCount();
3770 }
3771 else
3772 {
3773 return sizeof(typename ContainerType::ElementType);
3774 }
3775 }
3776
3777 template<typename ContainerType, typename TCanContinueCallback>
3778 static bool ContinueTimeSliceCopy(const ContainerType& ContainerFrom, ContainerType& ContainerTo, int32& InOutMaxSize, const TCanContinueCallback& CanContinueCallback)
3779 {
3780 int32 SizeCopied = 0;
3781
3782 for (int32 Index = ContainerTo.Num(); Index < ContainerFrom.Num() && CanContinueCallback(InOutMaxSize, SizeCopied); Index++)
3783 {
3784 AddToContainerHelper(ContainerFrom, ContainerTo, Index);
3785 SizeCopied += ContainerElementSizeHelper(ContainerFrom, Index);
3786 }
3787
3788 // Update the maximum size left
3789 if (InOutMaxSize > 0)
3790 {
3791 if (SizeCopied > InOutMaxSize)
3792 {
3793 InOutMaxSize = 0;
3794 }
3795 else
3796 {
3797 InOutMaxSize -= SizeCopied;
3798 }
3799 }
3800
3801 bool Done = ContainerTo.Num() == ContainerFrom.Num();
3802 return Done;
3803 }

3834 , DirtyElements(Other.DirtyElements)
3835 , bDynamicTree(Other.bDynamicTree)
3836 , RootNode(Other.RootNode)

3838 , FirstFreeLeafNode(Other.FirstFreeLeafNode)
3839 , CellHashToFlatArray(Other.CellHashToFlatArray)
3840 , FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices(Other.FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices)
3841 , DirtyElementsGridOverflow(Other.DirtyElementsGridOverflow)
3842 , DirtyElementTree(nullptr)
3843 , DirtyElementGridCellSize(Other.DirtyElementGridCellSize)
3844 , DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv(Other.DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv)
3845 , DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount(Other.DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount)
3846 , DirtyElementMaxPhysicalSizeInCells(Other.DirtyElementMaxPhysicalSizeInCells)
3847 , DirtyElementMaxCellCapacity(Other.DirtyElementMaxCellCapacity)
3848 , TreeStats(Other.TreeStats)
3849 , TreeExpensiveStats(Other.TreeExpensiveStats)
3850 , GlobalPayloads(Other.GlobalPayloads)

3853 , MaxTreeDepth(Other.MaxTreeDepth)

3858 , bModifyingTreeMultiThreadingFastCheck(Other.bModifyingTreeMultiThreadingFastCheck)
3859 , bShouldRebuild(Other.bShouldRebuild)
3860 , bBuildOverlapCache(Other.bBuildOverlapCache)
3861 , OverlappingLeaves(Other.OverlappingLeaves)
3862 , OverlappingOffsets(Other.OverlappingOffsets)
3863 , OverlappingPairs(Other.OverlappingPairs)
3864 , OverlappingCounts(Other.OverlappingCounts)
3865 {
3866 ensure(bDynamicTree == Other.IsTreeDynamic());
3867 PriorityQ.Reserve(32);
3868 if (Other.DirtyElementTree)
3869 {
3870 DirtyElementTree = TUniquePtr<TAABBTree>(new TAABBTree(*(Other.DirtyElementTree)));
3871 }
3872 }
3873
3874 virtual void DeepAssign(const ISpatialAcceleration<TPayloadType, T, 3>& Other) override
3875 {
3876 check(Other.GetType() == ESpatialAcceleration::AABBTree);
3877 *this = static_cast<const TAABBTree&>(Other);
3878 }
3879
3880 TAABBTree& operator=(const TAABBTree& Rhs)
3881 {
3882 ISpatialAcceleration<TPayloadType, T, 3>::DeepAssign(Rhs);
3883 ensure(Rhs.WorkStack.Num() == 0);
3884 //ensure(Rhs.WorkPool.Num() == 0);
3885 //ensure(Rhs.WorkPoolFreeList.Num() == 0);
3886 WorkStack.Empty();
3887 WorkPool.Empty();
3888 WorkPoolFreeList.Empty();
3889 if(this != &Rhs)
3890 {
3891 Nodes = Rhs.Nodes;
3892 Leaves = Rhs.Leaves;
3893 DirtyElements = Rhs.DirtyElements;
3894 bDynamicTree = Rhs.bDynamicTree;
3895 RootNode = Rhs.RootNode;
3896 FirstFreeInternalNode = Rhs.FirstFreeInternalNode;
3897 FirstFreeLeafNode = Rhs.FirstFreeLeafNode;
3898
3899 CellHashToFlatArray = Rhs.CellHashToFlatArray;
3900 FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices = Rhs.FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices;
3901 DirtyElementsGridOverflow = Rhs.DirtyElementsGridOverflow;
3902 TreeStats = Rhs.TreeStats;
3903 TreeExpensiveStats = Rhs.TreeExpensiveStats;
3904
3905 DirtyElementGridCellSize = Rhs.DirtyElementGridCellSize;
3906 DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv = Rhs.DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv;
3907 DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount = Rhs.DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount;
3908 DirtyElementMaxPhysicalSizeInCells = Rhs.DirtyElementMaxPhysicalSizeInCells;
3909 DirtyElementMaxCellCapacity = Rhs.DirtyElementMaxCellCapacity;
3910
3911 GlobalPayloads = Rhs.GlobalPayloads;
3912 PayloadToInfo = Rhs.PayloadToInfo;
3913 MaxChildrenInLeaf = Rhs.MaxChildrenInLeaf;
3914 MaxTreeDepth = Rhs.MaxTreeDepth;
3915 MaxPayloadBounds = Rhs.MaxPayloadBounds;
3916 MaxNumToProcess = Rhs.MaxNumToProcess;
3917 NumProcessedThisSlice = Rhs.NumProcessedThisSlice;
3918 StartSliceTimeStamp = Rhs.StartSliceTimeStamp;
3919 bModifyingTreeMultiThreadingFastCheck = Rhs.bModifyingTreeMultiThreadingFastCheck;
3920 bShouldRebuild = Rhs.bShouldRebuild;
3921 bBuildOverlapCache = Rhs.bBuildOverlapCache;
3922 if (Rhs.DirtyElementTree)
3923 {
3924 if (!DirtyElementTree)
3925 {
3926 DirtyElementTree = TUniquePtr<TAABBTree>(new TAABBTree());
3927 }
3928 *DirtyElementTree = *Rhs.DirtyElementTree;
3929 }
3930 else
3931 {
3932 DirtyElementTree = nullptr;
3933 }
3934 }
3935
3936 return *this;
3937 }
3938
3939 TArray<FNode> Nodes;
3940 TLeafContainer<TLeafType> Leaves;
3941 TArray<FElement> DirtyElements;
3942
3943 // DynamicTree members
3944 bool bDynamicTree = false;
3945 int32 RootNode = INDEX_NONE;
3946 // Free lists (indices are in Nodes array)
3947 int32 FirstFreeInternalNode = INDEX_NONE;
3948 int32 FirstFreeLeafNode = INDEX_NONE;
3949
3950 // Data needed for DirtyElement2DAccelerationGrid
3951 TMap<int32, DirtyGridHashEntry> CellHashToFlatArray; // Index, size into flat grid structure (FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices)
3952 TArray<int32> FlattenedCellArrayOfDirtyIndices; // Array of indices into dirty Elements array, indices are always sorted within a 2D cell
3953 TArray<int32> DirtyElementsGridOverflow; // Array of indices of DirtyElements that is not in the grid for some reason
3954
3955 // Members for using a dynamic tree as a dirty element acceleration structure
3956 TUniquePtr<TAABBTree> DirtyElementTree;
3957
3958 // Copy of CVARS
3959 T DirtyElementGridCellSize;
3960 T DirtyElementGridCellSizeInv;
3961 int32 DirtyElementMaxGridCellQueryCount;
3962 int32 DirtyElementMaxPhysicalSizeInCells;
3963 int32 DirtyElementMaxCellCapacity;
3964 // Some useful statistics
3965 AABBTreeStatistics TreeStats;
3966 AABBTreeExpensiveStatistics TreeExpensiveStats;
3967
3968 TArray<FElement> GlobalPayloads;
3969 typename StorageTraits::PayloadToInfoType PayloadToInfo;
3970
3971 int32 MaxChildrenInLeaf;
3972 int32 MaxTreeDepth;
3973 T MaxPayloadBounds;
3974 int32 MaxNumToProcess;
3975 int32 NumProcessedThisSlice;
3976
3977 double StartSliceTimeStamp = 0.0;
3978 int32 CurrentProcessedNodesSinceChecked = 0;
3979 int32 CurrentDataElementsCopiedSinceLastCheck = 0;
3980
3981 TArray<int32> WorkStack;
3982 TArray<int32> WorkPoolFreeList;
3983 TArray<FWorkSnapshot> WorkPool;
3984
3985 bool bModifyingTreeMultiThreadingFastCheck; // Used for fast but not perfect multithreading sanity check
3986
3987 bool bShouldRebuild; // Contract: this can only ever be cleared by calling the ClearShouldRebuild method
3988
3989 bool bBuildOverlapCache;
3991 TArray<int32> OverlappingLeaves;
3992
3994 TArray<int32> OverlappingOffsets;
3995
3997 TArray<FIntVector2> OverlappingPairs;
3998
4000 TArray<int32> OverlappingCounts;
4001
4006 using FNodeIndexAndCost = TTuple<FNode&, int32, FReal>;
4007 TArray<FNodeIndexAndCost> PriorityQ;
4008
4009 friend ::FChaosVDDataWrapperUtils;
4010};
4011
4012template<typename TPayloadType, typename TLeafType, bool bMutable, typename T, typename StorageTraits>
4013FArchive& operator<<(FChaosArchive& Ar, TAABBTree<TPayloadType, TLeafType, bMutable, T, StorageTraits>& AABBTree)
4014{
4015 AABBTree.Serialize(Ar);
4016 return Ar;
4017}
4018
4019}
